Do not use a close portrait crop. </composition> <scene> STAGE: a tactile broadcast analysis studio with one broad curved presentation wall, cameras, and an analog control console. scene_spec.setting: 붉은 안개가 낮게 깔린 실험실 분위기의 광장, 바닥에 균열이 있고 하늘은 짙은 주황빛
